title: Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness
subtitle: Genius Sonority · GameCube
summary: Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness is Genius Sonority's GameCube role-playing adventure returning to the region of Orre after Pokémon Colosseum. body: Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness is Genius Sonority's GameCube role-playing adventure returning to the region of Orre after Pokémon Colosseum. A new young trainer confronts Cipher's renewed use of Shadow Pokémon, with the imposing Shadow Lugia becoming the central image of the threat. The Snag Machine again allows the player to rescue affected creatures from opposing trainers. Double Battles carry the main journey, asking the developing party to respond to two enemies at once while preserving the opportunity to bring a Shadow Pokémon safely into the team.

Captured Shadow Pokémon need to be purified before they can fully return to ordinary life. Carrying one in the party remains useful, while the Purification Chamber lets the player arrange Pokémon into sets that support the process. The larger group therefore contributes beyond the six creatures currently travelling together. Shadow attacks create their own relationships in combat, and missed captures can receive another opportunity through returning rival Miror B. The rescue campaign connects the encounter in front of the player to the collection being cared for elsewhere.

Poké Spots introduce limited wild encounters after bait has attracted a creature, adding another route to expanding the collection. Battle SIMs and Battle Bingo provide challenges built around prepared teams or particular rules. The game also connects with the Game Boy Advance Pokémon titles for trading and battle. Released in 2005, XD developed the distinctive home-console approach established by Colosseum: a story-led journey whose Pokémon are encountered through another trainer's actions, then gradually restored through the player's attention after the fight has ended.
story_headings: Return to Orre and its Shadow Pokémon
Purification becomes a system to arrange
More ways to meet a Pokémon
